subject.title: feat(diagnostics-otel): add vendor-neutral session attribute option for OTel session grouping

question: Should OpenClaw expose an opt-in reset-bounded conversation identifier to telemetry, and which OTel attribute names are part of the supported contract?
rationale: The choice determines conversation grouping semantics, privacy/linkability across resets, and a new public config and telemetry contract; code review cannot safely choose those policies.

options.title: Use rotating conversation identity
options.body: Hash the event `sessionId`, centralize the helper, and emit the maintainer-approved standard attributes so `/new` or reset starts a distinct telemetry session.

options.title: Group by durable routing key
options.body: Keep hashing `sessionKey`, explicitly document that grouping survives conversation resets, and accept the broader correlation and privacy implications.

options.title: Defer session export
options.body: Close or pause the feature until a narrower privacy-preserving identifier and attribute contract are agreed.

recommendation.title: Use rotating conversation identity
recommendation.body: Hash the event `sessionId`, centralize the helper, and emit the maintainer-approved standard attributes so `/new` or reset starts a distinct telemetry session.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent diagnostics and OpenTelemetry ownership makes this person the best available decision router for the telemetry identity contract.
